query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iam_revoked_sessions WHERE session_id = $1)
                    AS "session_revoked!",
                (SELECT tokens_valid_after FROM iam_user_token_validity WHERE user_id = $2)
                    AS "user_cutoff?",
                (SELECT tokens_valid_after FROM iam_global_token_cutoff WHERE id = 1)
                    AS "global_cutoff?"
